title: Bullet Club’s civil war: Omega, Cody & the OGs
summary: Cody and Kenny Omega’s struggle for influence divides Bullet Club. Their eventual reconciliation arrives just as the faction’s original members launch a different rebellion.

chapters.title: Cody turns the leadership dispute violent
chapters.result: Cody attacks Omega after Omega’s loss to Jay White.
chapters.context: The assault brings the faction’s competing loyalties into the open and prompts Ibushi’s intervention.

chapters.title: The OGs attack after Omega beats Cody
chapters.result: Omega retains against Cody; Tama Tonga’s group attacks afterward.
chapters.context: Cody refuses to join the assault and helps his former rival. A leadership dispute becomes a wider split between the Elite and the OGs.
